finding: Numeric JSON with more than Decimal capacity can round during Foundation decoding
evidence: Swift6 production WalletNumericDecimal extraction reproduces rounding for a 41-significant-digit synthetic USD value; normal 19/38 digit tests and invalid-type tests pass
decision: This round keeps the existing Foundation Decimal numeric model rather than adding a raw-JSON arbitrary-precision parser. No actual provider payload demonstrates this magnitude. The report remains archived as a known numeric representation limit; not reported as a fixed defect.
Production signer/parser synthetic probes and independent signature calculation passed; root additionally found and fixed Widget visibility separately in 8c6427b. Nine real XCTest passed.

finding: Transient userinfo failure loses initial completed grant and requires new authorization
decision: Add bounded retry to read-only userinfo, never repeat authorization-code POST. Keep unverified identity out of persistent credentials. Rename misleading classification-only test.
validation: Twelve Google OAuth XCTest passed in /tmp/tokenpulse-wave4-cloud-providers-run.log; 55 combined tests zero failures.

finding: Active transport cancellation silently hides login result
decision: Show retry message for cancellation while active run is still current and task is not cancelled. Actual onDisappear/new-run cancellation remains silent. Pi theory that rejecting redirect necessarily emits cancelled is not established; no such causal claim adopted.
validation: Twelve Google OAuth XCTest passed in /tmp/tokenpulse-wave4-cloud-providers-run.log; 55 combined tests zero failures.

finding: Syntactically safe but unlikely Google client ID prefixes accepted
decision: Validation checks safe Google suffix and redirect syntax; Google decides whether an ID exists. Do not invent undocumented prefix length/numeric format restrictions.
Independent parser/project/identity/refresh probes passed. Root corrected a test API typo separately (5dd15e5); all 12 Gemini XCTest pass.

finding: Project input validation runs after OAuth and produces response error for bad input
decision: Validate user project before opening OAuth and before direct authorize exchange; use provider-specific validation and a useful input message.
validation: 713 full XCTest zero failures, including four new input/label regressions.

finding: Empty group displayName becomes empty scope and leading-space label
decision: Normalize empty/whitespace optional labels to nil or bucket ID fallback.
validation: 713 full XCTest zero failures, including four new input/label regressions.

decision: Root compilation found and fixed independently; subsequent 24 Kiro and 709 full XCTest pass.
Official schema has no pack ID or aggregation contract. Keep other quota pools and expose a stable unknown cohort with real expiry; do not add counts or fabricate per-pack identity.

finding: ACTIVE trial without expiry displayed without end date
decision: Keep valid ACTIVE quota and label expiry as unknown. Non-resetting does not imply never expires; reject/drop suggestion not adopted.

finding: Hardcoded service profile ARNs rather than metadata
decision: Locked official portal uses these same personal IdP profile mappings. Current supported IdPs match; unused meta value is not authoritative.

finding: Expired pending/uncertain token retains unusable refresh secret
decision: CAS terminal transition clears no-longer-usable refresh token; preserve no-replay and generation guards.

finding: iPhone may rebind identity on re-login unlike Watch
decision: Intentional account-owner behavior consistent with other providers: phone rebind clears old scope/cache; Watch authorizes against shared selected scope. Pi itself confirmed no old-scope reuse.

finding: Device-code begin WAF response classified as invalid credentials
decision: Treat mitigated/rate-limited startup consistently with other Nous endpoints.

finding: Transient identity GET after successful device grant loses login
decision: Bounded read-only account retry without replaying successful device grant POST or storing unverified identity.

finding: Phone rebind leaves Watch silently showing old account indefinitely
decision: Monitor binds credential against current config before network query; mismatch clears wrong-scope cache and fails explicitly. Add real merge/rebind regression; do not adopt static trace that skipped this guard.

finding: Rollover remaining above nominal monthly allowance inferred as zero used; zero partial count omitted; missing monthly reset marked non-resetting
decision: Preserve unknown used/percentage, explicit zero counts, and unknown reset time rather than inventing usage or no-reset semantics.
